The company applied computer vision and machine learning to satellite imagery, aerial photography, AIS vessel signals, and IoT/mobile location data to produce intelligence on supply chains, global commodities (notably oil storage via its Global Geospatial Crude Index), geopolitical events, demographics, retail foot traffic, disaster damage, and national-security questions. Its flagship product was the GO platform (later rebranded TerraScope), a self-service geospatial intelligence platform layering proprietary models over commercial satellite imagery from partners including DigitalGlobe, Airbus, Planet Labs, and e-GEOS. Orbital Insight raised funding from In-Q-Tel, GV (Google Ventures), Sequoia Capital, CME Ventures, and others, and acquired Boston-based FeatureX in 2018. After a period of financial distress in 2023, Orbital Insight was acquired by Privateer (co-founded by Apple's Steve Wozniak and Alex Fielding) on May 6, 2024. Following the acquisition, the standalone orbitalinsight.com brand was wound down and the TerraScope platform is now offered by Privateer alongside its Wayfinder space-domain-awareness data engine, fused into Privateer's "Elements" all-domain data platform. As of 2026 there is no public self-service Orbital Insight developer API, SDK, or open-source release; the orbitalinsight GitHub organization has only two archived repositories (a region-aggregation reference and a fork of tileserver-gl) and no current developer portal.

companies.name: Wheels Up
companies.description: Wheels Up Experience Inc. (NYSE: UP) is a leading on-demand private aviation provider in the U.S., offering charter and membership programs, commercial travel benefits through a strategic partnership with Delta Air Lines, and cargo services. Founded in 2013 by Kenny Dichter, Wheels Up was rescued from potential bankruptcy in September 2023 when a Delta Air Lines-led consortium (Delta, Certares, Knighthead, Cox) closed a $500M financing package and took a ~95% controlling equity stake. In November 2024 the company acquired the Embraer Phenom 300/300E fleet of GrandView Aviation ($105M) and secured $332M in equipment financing from Bank of America as part of a multi-year fleet modernization toward two core aircraft types (Phenom 300 series and Challenger 300/350). In 2025 it launched a new Signature membership portfolio and an industry-first integrated self-booking of Delta commercial flights inside the Wheels Up members app. Wheels Up does not publish a public developer API — its booking surface is a members-only mobile app and members.wheelsup.com web portal, with B2B operator connectivity historically routed through its acquired Avianis platform (2019).

companies.name: Aethero
companies.description: Aethero designs and manufactures radiation-hardened, space-rated edge computing systems and AI/ML software for satellites, space stations, and orbital data centers, enabling autonomous on-orbit processing of imagery and sensor data rather than downlinking raw feeds. Its NVIDIA Jetson Orin/Thor-based NxN-ECM and NxA-ECM edge computing modules, Titan and Phobos platforms, the Aether fleet-management software framework, and the AMATDT model annotation/training/deployment tool let spacecraft run AI inference in orbit. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in San Francisco, Aethero raised an $8.4M seed round led by Kindred Ventures in June 2025. Aethero exposes no public web API today; this profile captures the company's identity and its live domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Amprius Technologies
companies.description: Amprius Technologies is a Fremont, California-based developer and manufacturer of high-energy density lithium-ion batteries built on a proprietary 100% silicon anode platform. Its flagship SiCore and SiMaxx cell families are marketed as among the industry's highest gravimetric and volumetric energy density rechargeable cells, enabling longer endurance, faster charging, and higher payload capacity than conventional graphite-anode chemistries. Amprius targets aviation and aerospace (high-altitude pseudo-satellites, unmanned aerial systems, electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft), defense (US Army soldier-worn power, BAE Systems), light electric vehicles, robotics, and AI hardware. Public references include AALTO's Airbus-derived Zephyr HAPS programs, Prismatic's PHASA-35 stratospheric aircraft, Nokia Drone Networks, and Matternet drone delivery. The company runs pilot manufacturing and R&D in Fremont and is scaling a GWh-scale Brighton, Colorado plant alongside contract manufacturing partnerships in Asia. Amprius is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker AMPX. It is certified to ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100:2016. Amprius sells cells, modules, and engineering services to OEMs and defense primes; it does not publish a developer API, SDK, or open-source battery telemetry interface, and has no public GitHub organization.

companies.name: BlackSky
companies.description: BlackSky Technology (NYSE: BKSY) is a Herndon, Virginia headquartered real-time space-based intelligence company that operates a high-revisit Earth observation constellation and delivers AI-enhanced tactical ISR (intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance) imagery and analytics to defense, intelligence, and global security customers. BlackSky's flagship product is the Spectra platform — a cloud-based intelligence hub that provides on-demand satellite tasking, sub-90-minute imagery delivery, automated AI-driven object detection and change monitoring, archived imagery access, and a secure tasking and delivery API. The company operates Gen-2 satellites at 83 cm resolution and a newer Gen-3 constellation delivering 35 cm class very-high-resolution imagery with infrared sensors, inter-satellite links, and on-board AI processing, manufactured at BlackSky's facility in Tukwila, Washington. Commercial offerings include BlackSky ON-DEMAND (flexible global tasking) and BlackSky ASSURED (dedicated, contracted persistent monitoring capacity). BlackSky's Spectra tasking and imagery API is integrated into partner platforms including Esri ArcGIS, UP42, and the STAT (Satellite Tasking API) community spec, however the API is access-controlled for vetted defense, intelligence, and enterprise customers and is not exposed as a public self-service developer portal — there is no public Spectra developer documentation site, OpenAPI specification, or open SDKs at the time of this entry. The customer revenue model is subscription-based Spectra ON-DEMAND and ASSURED contracts, Mission Solutions custom engagements, and through marketplace partners.

companies.name: Fortastra
companies.description: Fortastra is a spacecraft manufacturer building low-cost, maneuverable orbital defense systems designed for scalability and autonomous operation. Its spacecraft protect space-based infrastructure with autonomous navigation that detects, analyzes, and responds to orbital anomalies without relying on distant ground-based sensors. The company's open software architecture spans sensing, maneuvering, coordination, and response functions, and its hardware is validated through component testing, simulation, and orbital deployment. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bloomberg-beta.

companies.name: GITAI
companies.description: GITAI is a space robotics company building safe and affordable robotic labor for space. It develops robotic arms, spacecraft platforms, autonomous "Inchworm" robots, and lunar rovers for on-orbit servicing, satellite assembly and maintenance, and lunar and orbital infrastructure construction, working with customers and agencies such as NASA and JAXA. GITAI operates as a B2B and government contractor and does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, SDK, or developer documentation; this profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched with the publicly observable web, blog, and domain-security surface only.

companies.name: Inversion
companies.description: Inversion is a Los Angeles-based aerospace and defense company founded in 2021 by Austin Briggs and Justin Fiaschetti, building a new class of highly maneuverable reentry vehicles. Its flagship Arc is an autonomous, reusable, low-cost space-based delivery vehicle designed to store cargo in orbit and deliver it with precision to anywhere on Earth in under an hour, descending under parachutes using non-toxic propellants so crews can approach it immediately on landing. The company also develops hypersonics and space-based interceptor technology and flew its first reentry capsule, Ray, as an early technical demonstrator. Inversion has raised roughly $54M to date, including a $44M Series A led by Spark Capital and Adjacent with participation from Lockheed Martin Ventures, Kindred Ventures, and Y Combinator. It does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile tracks the company for the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Inversion Space
companies.description: Inversion Space is a Los Angeles-based aerospace and defense company founded in 2021 by Justin Fiaschetti and Austin Briggs, building autonomous, reusable, and low-cost reentry vehicles that turn space into a global logistics network. Its Arc vehicle is designed to store cargo in orbit and deliver a 500-pound payload to anywhere on Earth in under an hour, while its first spacecraft, Ray, validated key reentry subsystems. The company also develops hypersonic test capabilities and space-based interceptor technology, partnering with Anduril on the Golden Dome program and Kratos on the MACH-TB 2.0 hypersonic test program, backed by a $71M U.S. Space Force contract. It is in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface was found during enrichment.

companies.name: MightyFly
companies.description: MightyFly is an autonomous air-logistics company building hybrid-electric eVTOL cargo aircraft for expedited, long-range, same-day deliveries. Its autonomous aircraft carry up to 500 pounds, travel up to 1,000 miles at roughly 150 MPH, and cut delivery emissions by around 64% versus traditional ground and air freight. MightyFly targets B2B logistics and defense delivery partnerships rather than offering a public developer platform. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no developer API, SDK, developer portal, or public specifications; this profile captures its public web presence and probed domain-security posture.

companies.name: Momentus
companies.description: Momentus is a U.S.-based commercial space company providing in-space transportation and infrastructure services. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in San Jose, California, the publicly traded company (NASDAQ: MNTS) designs, manufactures, and operates Orbital Service Vehicles such as its Vigoride platform, using water plasma propulsion technology to move satellites and payloads between orbits, host payloads, and deliver last-mile satellite deployment. Momentus serves private satellite operators, government agencies, and research institutions. As of this profile it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or technical integration surface; it was surfaced as a Y Combinator (S18) portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

companies.name: Nabhdrishti Aerospace
companies.description: Nabhdrishti Aerospace is a Bangalore-based deep-tech startup building India's first fuel-flex micro gas turbine for aviation and power generation. Its ND 400 engine is a 400 N single-core micro gas turbine designed for UAVs, hybrid-electric aircraft, and small aircraft as well as oil & gas, manufacturing, and vehicle range-extender power generation, running on conventional fuels, biofuels, and hydrogen with an innovative recuperator design that targets greater than 15% efficiency at under half the cost of competing turbines. Backed by Accel, the company raised USD 3M and operates from the IISc Bangalore IHUB. As a hardware manufacturer it publishes no public API, SDK, or developer platform; this profile tracks its public web presence.

companies.name: Orbital Operations
companies.description: Orbital Operations is a space-defense technology company founded in 2024 and based in Huntington Beach, California, developing high-thrust, cryogenic-powered orbital vehicles for rapid-response satellite defense, interception, and in-orbit repositioning. Its flagship Astraeus vehicle uses liquid-hydrogen propulsion with a proprietary zero-boil-off (ZBO) cryogenic storage system enabling in-space refueling and efficient payload transport between LEO, MEO, GEO, and lunar orbits. Backed by Initialized Capital, the company builds spaceflight hardware and does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

companies.name: Science Applications International Corporation (SAIC)
companies.description: Science Applications International Corporation (SAIC) is a Reston, Virginia based technology integrator that delivers mission IT, enterprise IT, engineering services, and professional services to U.S. federal civilian, defense, intelligence community, and space customers. With approximately 24,000 employees and roughly $7.3 billion in annual revenue, SAIC focuses on direct technical support and integration for government organizations, spanning CJADC2, data and AI, digital transformation, quantum technologies, cloud, cybersecurity, digital workplace, digital engineering, and systems integration. SAIC has expanded its capabilities through acquisitions including Engility (2018), Unisys Federal (2020), Halfaker (2021, DoD healthcare), Koverse (2021, secure data lake for classified environments), and Forfeiture Support Associates (2023). No public REST APIs, developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, or open source GitHub organization have been identified for SAIC — its software and platforms are delivered under federal contract to government customers rather than as externally-consumable developer products.

companies.name: Starcloud
companies.description: Starcloud is developing orbital data centers that run AI and high-performance compute in space. The company aims to deploy hyperscale, gigawatt-scale infrastructure in orbit, using continuous solar energy without batteries and radiative cooling into the vacuum to lower cost, scale beyond terrestrial siting and permitting limits, and deploy rapidly. Backed by Nvidia, Sequoia, Andreessen Horowitz, NFX and others, Starcloud is building a roadmap of Starcloud-1 through Starcloud-4 satellite compute platforms. As of this profile the company exposes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or technical documentation surface; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a space-compute infrastructure company and lead for future enrichment.

companies.name: Tekever
companies.description: Tekever is a multinational defence technology company headquartered in Lisbon, Portugal, with operations in the United Kingdom (Bath and a planned large-scale drone production facility in Swindon), France (Toulouse and Cahors), and the United States (Fayetteville, North Carolina). Founded in 2001, the company specialises in AI-driven autonomy for civil and defence missions, with its core business centred on long-endurance Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) used for Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR), maritime surveillance, and electronic warfare. Its flagship platforms include the AR3, a configurable medium-range tactical UAS (designated StormShroud in service with the UK Royal Air Force), the AR5, a SATCOM-enabled long-endurance maritime and land ISR aircraft, and the ARX, a next-generation system positioned as the company's game changer. These platforms are paired with ATLAS, Tekever's real-time intelligence-as-a-service platform that fuses sensor and satellite data into actionable mission intelligence. Tekever drones are operated by the UK Ministry of Defence, the British Army, the Armed Forces of Ukraine (with the UK having committed approximately £270 million in Tekever UAVs for Ukraine since the start of the Russian invasion), the European Maritime Safety Agency under a €30 million contract, the French Ministry of Armed Forces (CNES/DGA), Portugal, and NATO. The company also develops satellite technology and Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) capabilities to extend its intelligence services beyond the airborne domain. Tekever's revenue model is built on government and defence contracts, platform sales, and managed ISR-as-a-service offerings; it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or open-source release, and engagement with the company is conducted through direct sales, government procurement, and partnership channels.

companies.name: Xona Space Systems
companies.description: Xona Space Systems builds Pulsar, a commercial low-Earth-orbit (LEO) positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) satellite service designed to complement and harden GPS with centimeter-level accuracy and encrypted, jam-resistant signals usable by existing GNSS devices via software updates. The planned constellation is 258 small satellites at roughly 1,080 km altitude, with the Pulsar Verified ecosystem (receivers, simulators, test platforms) delivered through partners including Trimble, Septentrio, Topcon, Furuno, and Murata. A Craft Ventures portfolio company serving defense, agriculture, telecom, transportation, maritime, aviation, and autonomous systems. No public developer API surface was found as of July 2026.

companies.name: Zeno Power
companies.description: Zeno Power is a deep-tech energy company developing radioisotope power systems (nuclear batteries) that convert the heat of radioisotope decay into reliable, long-duration electricity for extreme environments where conventional power sources fail. Its compact radioisotope Stirling generators target 1-100+ watts for use cases spanning NASA lunar surface missions (americium-241 fueled), seabed and maritime sensor infrastructure, and Department of Defense / U.S. Space Force applications (strontium-90 fueled). The company works with partners including NASA, the Pentagon, Westinghouse, and Orano, with commercial market delivery targeted for 2027. Backed by DCVC, Zeno Power was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; enrichment found no public API, developer platform, SDKs, or technical documentation surface as of this pass.

companies.name: AirMap
companies.description: AirMap was a drone airspace-management and unmanned traffic management (UTM) platform that provided airspace intelligence, flight planning, digital notice, and geofencing services for drones and their operators, exposed through a developer platform of airspace and flight APIs. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of bullpen-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead. As of this enrichment pass (2026-07) the company appears defunct: airmap.com no longer serves a developer portal or API and now resolves to a parked Squarespace-hosted page with a mismatched TLS certificate, and the legacy developer.airmap.com / api.airmap.com / docs.airmap.com hosts no longer resolve. No live API surface remains to harvest.

companies.name: Akash Systems
companies.description: Akash Systems is an Oakland, California deep-tech semiconductor company that pioneers Diamond Cooling thermal-management technology, integrating synthetic diamond directly with semiconductors such as Gallium Nitride (GaN) to remove heat up to five times faster than copper. Its Chip-on-Diamond and diamond-cooled server products target AI and data-center compute, while its GaN power amplifiers and satellite radios serve space communications, radar, cellular, and automotive/EV markets. Akash Systems is a hardware and materials company with no public developer API or documentation surface; it was surfaced as a DCVC portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment.

companies.name: Albedo
companies.description: Albedo is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of initialized-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: frontier-tech. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

companies.name: Aliena
companies.description: Aliena is a Singapore-based space-technology company, incorporated in 2018, that designs and manufactures compact electric propulsion systems for small satellites. Its MUSIC plasma thruster line delivers high thrust-to-power ratios at very low power budgets with high specific impulse, enabling small satellites to operate and sustain very low Earth orbit (VLEO) for high-resolution remote sensing. Aliena is a hardware manufacturer with no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a 500 Global portfolio lead.

companies.name: Apex Space
companies.description: Apex Space (Apex) is a Los Angeles based satellite manufacturing company that builds productized, configurable spacecraft bus platforms for proliferated constellations across LEO, MEO, and GEO orbital regimes. Apex offers three product lines: Aries (small satellites up to 150 kg payload), Nova (medium satellites up to 300 kg payload), and Comet (large satellites up to 3,000 kg payload), and operates Factory One, a high-rate manufacturing facility in Los Angeles with the capacity to produce more than 200 satellites annually. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network. Apex does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or developer documentation; customers configure satellite platforms through the on-site Configurator and direct sales inquiries.

companies.name: Atomic Alchemy
companies.description: Atomic Alchemy is a deep-tech nuclear company that designs, builds, and operates non-power research reactors to manufacture high-value radioisotopes for medical, research, industrial, defense, and space applications. Its proprietary Versatile Isotope Production Reactor (VIPR) technology and Meitner-1 facility are intended to create a scalable, onshore supply of isotopes such as molybdenum-99 (for cancer diagnostics and treatment), strontium-90, and americium-241, reducing US dependence on foreign isotope production. Founded by CEO Thomas Eiden and headquartered in Idaho Falls, Idaho, the company was backed by DCVC and Y Combinator and was acquired by advanced-fission company Oklo (NYSE: OKLO) in early 2025, operating as a wholly owned subsidiary. In 2026 the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission granted Atomic Alchemy a materials license to handle, process, and distribute isotopes. As a physical radioisotope manufacturer, Atomic Alchemy publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification; this profile captures company identity only.

companies.name: Basalt
companies.description: Basalt (Basalt Technologies Corp.) is a San Francisco spacecraft-software company building Dispatch, a simulation-based operating system for satellites that makes flight software portable across dissimilar spacecraft hardware — pitched as "Windows for spacecraft" and "Constellations as a Service." Dispatch provides a common control layer so fleets of different satellites can work together on tasking (visible, infrared, and radar imaging), in-orbit networking and telecom, signals intelligence, and monitoring or inspecting other on-orbit assets, including autonomous re-tasking for national security missions. Founded in 2023 by Max Bhatti and Alex Choi (ex-SpaceX engineers, MIT CubeSat program), Basalt is a Y Combinator W24 company that raised a $3.5M seed round led by Initialized Capital in May 2024, with participation from Y Combinator, Liquid 2 Ventures, and General Catalyst. The company publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface; this profile captures its identity and probed domain security. Sector: frontier-tech / space / defense.

companies.name: Beyond Reach Labs
companies.description: Beyond Reach Labs is a Brooklyn, New York aerospace company building deployable solar arrays and thermal radiators for spacecraft that expand from compact launch sizes to enormous structures in orbit. Its patented geometry-changing panels grow from the size of a dining table to a football field once deployed, giving satellites, orbital data centers, commercial space stations, and lunar outposts up to 10x more usable power without adding launch mass or volume. Founded by two aerospace engineers, the company is targeting its first in-space demonstration in Q2 2027 and is a Y Combinator portfolio company. Beyond Reach Labs is a hardware manufacturer and does not currently publish a public API or developer program.

companies.name: Deice
companies.description: De-Ice Technologies is an aviation deep-tech company that develops a fast, chemical-free aircraft de-icing system to replace traditional glycol chemical spray methods. Spun out of MIT in 2015 by co-founders Alexander Bratianu-Badea and Ruben Toubiana, the Somerville, Massachusetts company uses gallium nitride (GaN) semiconductors to generate high-frequency electric current through tape-like strips attached to an aircraft's exterior, melting snow and ice during the boarding window instead of the usual 30-45 minute glycol spray delay. The approach eliminates glycol spraying costs and the carbon emissions from idling and chemical production/transport, improving airline on-time performance. Air Canada is the launch customer, and the technology was featured in Time's Best Inventions of 2024. De-Ice is a portfolio company of Playground Global. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; De-Ice publishes no public API, SDK, or developer surface at this time.

companies.name: DISH Network
companies.description: DISH Network is a U.S. television provider offering satellite and streaming TV services, as well as wireless services through its Boost Mobile and DISH Wireless brands. DISH is now part of EchoStar following the 2024 merger that brought DISH and Hughes back together under one parent. No public consumer-facing developer APIs are documented; the Boost Mobile and DISH Wireless networks are operated on a 5G Open RAN architecture.

companies.name: EchoStar
companies.description: EchoStar Corporation (Nasdaq: SATS) is a global, fully integrated communications and content delivery leader and provider of technology, spectrum, and connectivity. Through its DISH, Boost Mobile, Hughes, and EchoStar Mobile brands, EchoStar delivers satellite communications, wireless services, and IoT connectivity to consumers, enterprises, governments, and aviation customers worldwide.

companies.name: Enhanced Radar
companies.description: Enhanced Radar is a San Francisco-based applied AI company building intelligent systems for aviation, the world's most complex transportation domain. Its work centers on pilot-controller communications, where the company owns the full pipeline from data collection through in-house labeling and quality assurance to produce high-quality aviation AI training datasets. Products include Pattern, an aviation operational intelligence platform; ATC.com, a live air traffic control radio service; and Y4, an aviation understanding model announced in February 2026. Enhanced Radar has demonstrated real-time detection of runway incursion risks and raised $7 million in May 2026. It is backed by DCVC and Initialized Capital. The company does not currently publish a public API, developer documentation, or SDKs.

companies.name: EraDrive
companies.description: EraDrive is a space technology company building compact, AI-powered self-driving modules that give spacecraft onboard autonomy — vision-based navigation, control, collision avoidance, and situational awareness computed at the edge. A Stanford Space Rendezvous Laboratory (SLAB) spinoff founded by Sumant Sharma (CEO), Justin Kruger (CTO), and Prof. Simone D'Amico (CSO), EraDrive integrates flight-proven autonomy software with existing satellite infrastructure for space traffic management, on-orbit servicing and logistics, and advanced remote sensing across commercial and defense missions. The company closed an oversubscribed $5.3M seed round in December 2025, co-led by Haystack Ventures with participation from Point Nine, Harpoon Ventures, Brave Capital, 2100 VC, and Entropy Industrial Capital. As an early-stage hardware/software company, EraDrive currently publishes no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface.

companies.name: Ethereal Exploration Guild
companies.description: Ethereal Exploration Guild (EtherealX) is an Indian spacetech company founded in 2022 in Bengaluru by Manu J. Nair, Prashant Sharma, and Shubhayu Sardar, building fully reusable medium-lift launch vehicles. Its lead product, the Razor Crest Mk-1 (RCM1), targets roughly 25 tons to low Earth orbit with high launch cadence, up to 16 orbit insertions per flight, and 72-96 hour turnaround. The company has manufactured its 80kN reusable upper-stage engine (Pegasus) using a proprietary Full Flow Segregated Cooling Cycle (FFSCC) and operates a large private rocket testing facility in Cuddalore, Tamil Nadu. EtherealX has raised on the order of $26M across multiple rounds, including a Series A in December 2025. The company offers launch services rather than any developer-facing API or platform.

companies.name: GAGO Group
companies.description: GAGO Group (Beijing Jiage Tianyu Technology Co., Ltd.) is a China-based frontier-technology company focused on agricultural and rural big data applications. Its homepage positions the business around agricultural and rural big data, applying remote-sensing and data-analytics techniques to agriculture. GAGO Group is backed by DCM Ventures and was added to the API Evangelist network from that portfolio. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a corporate website at gagogroup.cn but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification could be verified, so no spec-derived API artifacts were produced.

companies.name: General Aviation
companies.description: General Aviation is a Y Combinator-backed startup (Spring 2026 batch) building a new air traffic control (ATC) system by connecting aircraft to the internet. Founded by Ben Frank, the company develops remote ATC tower technology aimed at the roughly 90 percent of airports in the U.S. National Airspace System that currently operate without control towers, giving smaller airfields an affordable path to the safety and efficiency benefits of tower services without the cost of traditional tower infrastructure and staffing. As of this profile the company operates a single marketing landing page and publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface.

companies.name: General Electric
companies.description: General Electric Company has reorganized into separate publicly traded companies: GE Aerospace, focused on jet engines and aviation systems, and GE Vernova, focused on energy and power generation. GE HealthCare was spun off in 2023. No unified public developer API portal is currently published by GE Aerospace or GE Vernova.

companies.name: Generalastro
companies.description: General Astronautics (Generalastro) is a Y Combinator (W26) space-robotics company founded in 2025 by Bram Schork, based in San Francisco, building autonomous dexterous robotic arms that perform laboratory research and manufacturing tasks in microgravity without astronaut intervention. Its systems handle work like pipetting, sample prep, plate handling, and reagent mixing, targeting microgravity production of pharmaceuticals, semiconductors, and fiber optics where crew time on orbital stations is the bottleneck (NASA estimates ISS crew time at ~$130K/hour). The company is pre-product hardware, backed by Y Combinator and Planet Ventures (~$7.1M raised), and currently exposes no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDK, or other machine-readable surface; this profile captures company identity only.

companies.name: Gilmour Space
companies.description: Gilmour Space Technologies is an Australian venture-backed space company headquartered on the Gold Coast in Queensland, founded in 2012 by brothers Adam and James Gilmour. The company designs and manufactures hybrid-propulsion orbital launch vehicles (the Eris rocket) and satellite platforms (the G-class / ElaraSat bus), and operates the Bowen Orbital Spaceport in North Queensland from which it is pursuing Australia's first sovereign orbital launch. Gilmour Space is backed by investors including Blackbird Ventures, Main Sequence Ventures, 500 Global, Fine Structure Ventures and HESTA. It is added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; the company operates in aerospace and space launch and does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

companies.name: Hawaiian Holdings
companies.description: Hawaiian Holdings was the parent company of Hawaiian Airlines, the largest and longest-serving airline of Hawaii, providing scheduled passenger service to destinations across the Pacific. In 2024 the company combined with Alaska Air Group, and Hawaiian Holdings became a wholly-owned subsidiary of Alaska Air Group. No public developer portal or production-facing APIs are advertised.

companies.name: HawkEye 360
companies.description: HawkEye 360 is a Herndon, Virginia-based radio frequency (RF) data analytics and geospatial intelligence company that operates the first commercial satellite constellation purpose-built to identify, process, and geolocate a broad range of RF signals from space. Founded in 2015 by Chris DeMay, Charles Clancy, and Bob McGwier, the company flies clusters of three small satellites in formation that use time- and frequency-difference-of-arrival triangulation to pinpoint emitters across VHF through Ku-band. As of 2025, HawkEye 360 has placed 36 Hawk satellites on orbit across 12 operational clusters. Its core products include RFGeo (the underlying RF signal mapping and geolocation data product), RFIQ (its RF intelligence data product recently selected by NASA Commercial LEO programs), and Mission Space, a web-based RF geospatial intelligence analysis platform. The company also offers a Regional Awareness Subscription (RAS) service providing persistent monitoring of high-interest regions such as the Mediterranean, South China Sea, and the Korean Peninsula. In December 2023 HawkEye 360 acquired Maxar Intelligence's RF Solutions business (formerly Aurora Insight), expanding its spectrum-mapping capabilities. Customers are concentrated in defense, intelligence, national security, and maritime domain awareness — including the US Government, allied partners, and foreign military sales (a 2025 FMS to India was approved by the Defense Security Cooperation Agency). HawkEye 360 has filed an S-1 with the SEC for a proposed IPO. There is no public, self-service developer API, SDK, or open-source release; data access is delivered through gated commercial and government contracts via the Mission Space platform and a customer-facing API for ordering and integration of RF analytics into customer systems.

companies.name: Hop Aero
companies.description: Hop Aero is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) aerospace and defense company based in Los Angeles, California, founded in 2024 by Jacob Balaj and Matija Milenovic. The company develops hypersonic rocket cargo vehicles that deliver payloads point-to-point into austere, contested environments hundreds of miles away in minutes, aiming to give the United States and its allies an asymmetric logistics advantage. Hop Aero has raised a $3M pre-seed round and won a $1.25M U.S. Air Force SBIR award; its team draws on experience from SpaceX, Virgin Orbit, Masten Space Systems, SpinLaunch, and Destinus. This is a hardware-stage company with no public API or developer surface at the time of profiling; this record was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and is maintained for network discovery and enrichment.

companies.name: Iridium
companies.description: Iridium Communications Inc. (NASDAQ: IRDM) is a McLean, Virginia satellite communications company operating a constellation of 66 cross-linked Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites that deliver truly global L-band voice, data, IoT, and positioning/navigation/timing (PNT) services across every region of the Earth, including the polar oceans. Iridium sells satellite phones (Iridium Extreme), satellite messengers, satellite IoT modules and modems (Iridium 9602/9603, Iridium Certus 9770/9810/9704, Iridium Edge, Iridium Edge Pro, Iridium Edge Solar), Short Burst Data (SBD) messaging, broadband Certus terminals, and next-generation Iridium NTN Direct 5G Non-Terrestrial Network services built on 3GPP NB-IoT for direct-to-device smartphone and IoT connectivity. Iridium CloudConnect — co-developed with Amazon Web Services — pipes satellite IoT data as JSON into customer-owned Amazon SQS queues inside their own AWS VPC over a dedicated private Iridium-AWS interconnect, making Iridium the first global cloud-native satellite IoT backhaul. The company serves aviation, maritime, government/defense, land-mobile, autonomous systems, and IoT markets through a partner ecosystem of more than 500 service providers, value-added resellers, and hardware OEMs, and in May 2026 announced a planned acquisition of Aireon, operator of the world's only space-based air traffic surveillance network. Iridium's business model is airtime/subscription revenue plus hardware module licensing and engineering services; there is no public, self-service developer API or OpenAPI — network access is mediated through Iridium-authorized service providers, the Iridium CloudConnect AWS integration, and hardware-level AT-command and SBD interfaces on Iridium modems.

companies.name: Iris Automation
companies.description: Iris Automation was a Reno, Nevada deep-tech company that built Casia, a computer-vision detect-and-avoid (DAA) system enabling beyond-visual-line-of-sight (BVLOS) drone operations. Its onboard products (Casia, Casia X) and the ground-based Casia G used industrial cameras and machine-learning to detect non-cooperative intruder aircraft and prevent near mid-air collisions, integrating with MavLink-based autopilots and UAS ground control systems. Iris Automation was acquired by uAvionix in late 2023; the irisonboard.com domain now 301-redirects to uAvionix and the company exposes no public developer API, documentation, or well-known surface of its own.

companies.name: K2 Space
companies.description: K2 Space (K2 Space Corporation) is a Los Angeles / Torrance, California aerospace startup that designs and manufactures high-power "Mega Class" satellite buses. Its platforms deliver roughly 20kW of array power and up to one metric ton of payload capacity - about ten times the power and payload of conventional buses - to maximize the throw-weight of next-generation launch vehicles like SpaceX Starship and Blue Origin New Glenn. K2 builds radiation-tolerant, vertically integrated (80% in-house) spacecraft with redundant avionics and high-delta-v propulsion for LEO, MEO, GEO and cislunar missions, serving commercial and U.S. government / defense customers. Backed by First Round Capital, Lightspeed Venture Partners and Redpoint Ventures, the company raised a $250M Series C at a $3B valuation and is preparing its first production satellite, GRAVITAS. K2 Space is a hardware company with no public developer API; this profile tracks its identity and web presence in the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Kyten Technologies
companies.description: Kyten Technologies is a Seattle, Washington hardware manufacturing startup building a factory to produce custom aerospace-grade battery packs. The founders spent six years at Starlink, where they put more than 5,000 battery packs into space, and are now bringing rapid development and volume production of aerospace-grade battery packs to the wider industry. The company positions itself against a legacy supply chain that cannot keep up with the 100,000+ drones, submarines, and satellites being built in the United States. Kyten Technologies is a Y Combinator Winter 2026 company, classified under Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics, and was an early-stage two-person team at the time of profiling. As a hardware manufacturer it publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API artifacts; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

companies.name: Lunasonde
companies.description: Lunasonde is a Techstars-backed deep-tech space company building a satellite constellation for subsurface Earth imaging. Its sensing technology aims to scan beneath the surface from orbit to detect groundwater, minerals, and other underground features, delivering the resulting geophysical data to mining, agriculture, water, and natural-resource customers. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, documentation portal, SDK, or machine-readable API surface; this record captures its verifiable web and domain-security footprint for the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Lydian
companies.description: Lydian (Lydian Labs) develops modular, turnkey plants that produce sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) from captured CO2 and hydrogen. Its technology converts carbon dioxide and electrolytic hydrogen into jet fuel via a syngas production process compatible with existing aircraft, targeting deployment in under two years and capital costs roughly 50% lower than conventional SAF plants. The company markets to airlines, fuel buyers, and facility operators. Based in Charlestown, Massachusetts, Lydian is backed by Union Square Ventures. This is a hardware/industrial company with no public API, SDK, or developer portal surface at the time of enrichment.

companies.name: Mantari
companies.description: Mantari is a weather-intelligence and earth-sensing company building a decision-intelligence platform that fuses a distributed network of sensors with AI to turn environmental data across oceans, skies, and space into mission-critical, actionable intelligence. It initially targets government and defense decision support, with plans to extend into broader economic and commercial applications. As of this profile Mantari publishes a marketing homepage and a careers page but no public API, developer portal, documentation, or SDKs; this record captures its identity plus a live domain-security probe, pending a future developer surface.

companies.name: Nexus Lab Technologies, Inc.
companies.description: Nexus Lab (Nexus Lab Technologies, Inc.) is a contrail-reduction software company founded in 2022 and backed by 500 Global. Operating from nexuslab.fr, it applies machine learning to satellite imagery, flight traffic data, and meteorological parameters to help airlines optimize flight paths and reduce contrail formation, mitigating aviation's non-CO2 climate impact. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes only a marketing website with no public API, developer portal, documentation, or SDKs; no developer surface was found to catalog.

companies.name: OptoAtmospherics
companies.description: OptoAtmospherics, Inc. is an Ann Arbor, Michigan company (founded 2009, spun out of Michigan Aerospace Corporation) that develops UV-based Light Detection and Ranging (LIDAR) systems for the wind energy industry. Its laser-based atmospheric measurement products deliver continuous wind speed, direction, temperature, and density reporting from turbine-mounted or ground-based platforms, with real-time detection of wind gusts, shear, and turbulence to improve site assessment, increase energy output, and protect turbine equipment. The business is a hardware and atmospheric-sensing venture; it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or software platform. Its former domain (optoatmospherics.com) is now parked/for-sale and the product line lives on under michiganaerospace.com/optoatmospherics/.

companies.name: Orbital ATK
companies.description: Orbital ATK was an American aerospace manufacturer and defense industry company formed in February 2015 by the merger of Orbital Sciences Corporation and the defense and aerospace divisions of Alliant Techsystems. The company produced launch vehicles, satellites, missiles, ammunition, precision-guided munitions, rocket motors, and the Cygnus spacecraft for ISS resupply before being acquired by Northrop Grumman on June 6, 2018 and rebranded as Northrop Grumman Innovation Systems.

companies.name: Pratt & Whitney
companies.description: A major American aerospace manufacturer designing, manufacturing, and servicing aircraft engines for commercial, military, and business aviation applications. A division of RTX Corporation (formerly Raytheon Technologies), Pratt & Whitney is known for its geared turbofan (GTF) engine technology (PW1000G family) powering the Airbus A220 and A320neo, the F135 powering the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter, and the PT6 turboprop family. Customer-facing digital services - EngineWise health monitoring, FAST (Full-flight data Acquisition Storage and Transmission), and the Customer Portal - are operated privately for airline, MRO, and military customers behind credentialed access and are not exposed as a public developer API or open partner integration portal.

companies.name: Pulse Space
companies.description: Pulse (Pulse - Space Power Solutions) is a Techstars-backed space technology company building power solutions for spacecraft and satellites. The company operates a WebGL marketing site at pulsespace.com and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; enrichment probing confirmed a marketing-only web presence (TLS 1.3 with HSTS) and no developer or API surface to harvest.

companies.name: Rocket Lab
companies.description: Rocket Lab (Rocket Lab Corporation, formerly Rocket Lab USA; Nasdaq RKLB) is an American aerospace manufacturer and end-to-end space company founded in 2006 by Peter Beck. It designs and launches the Electron small-lift orbital rocket, is developing the reusable Neutron medium-lift vehicle, and builds the Photon spacecraft platform along with satellites, spacecraft components, solar cells, reaction wheels, star trackers, separation systems and other space systems. Rocket Lab operates launch complexes in Mahia, New Zealand and at Wallops Island, Virginia, providing dedicated and rideshare launch services plus on-orbit management for commercial, civil and national-security customers. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Khosla Ventures; this profile is enriched from public identity and live domain probes only, as Rocket Lab publishes no public developer API surface.

companies.name: Skybox Imaging
companies.description: Skybox Imaging was a high-resolution Earth-observation smallsat startup founded in 2009 out of Stanford University, building the SkySat constellation of small satellites to capture sub-meter commercial imagery and video. Backed by Canaan Partners among other venture investors, it was acquired by Google in 2014 for roughly $500M, renamed Terra Bella in 2016, and then sold to Planet Labs in 2017. The company no longer exists as an independent entity and publishes no live developer API, docs, or discovery surface; this profile is retained as a portfolio-graph node for canaan-partners.

companies.name: Skyboximaging
companies.description: Skybox Imaging was a satellite imaging and geospatial-analytics company (founded 2009, Mountain View, CA) that built a constellation of small high-resolution Earth-observation satellites (SkySat) and the analytics to turn frequent imagery into commercial insight. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners, Bessemer, Khosla Ventures and others, it was acquired by Google in 2014 (~$500M), renamed Terra Bella, and its satellite business was sold to Planet Labs in 2017. The skyboximaging.com domain is no longer a live product surface; this profile is retained in the API Evangelist network for portfolio-graph and historical reference.

companies.name: SpinLaunch
companies.description: SpinLaunch is a space technology company developing a kinetic launch system that uses a rotating carbon-fiber arm inside a large vacuum chamber to accelerate launch vehicles to thousands of kilometers per hour before ignition, aiming to eliminate up to 70 percent of the fuel and structure of a conventional rocket. It operates a Suborbital Accelerator test facility at Spaceport America in New Mexico that doubles as a customer payload-testing platform, and is developing an Orbital Launch System alongside its Meridian satellite broadband constellation for enterprise connectivity. Backed by GV, the company currently publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

companies.name: Swarm Technologies
companies.description: Swarm Technologies is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of social-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: space. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

companies.name: Terra Bella (fka Skybox Imaging)
companies.description: Terra Bella, originally founded in 2009 as Skybox Imaging (Mountain View, California), was a satellite imaging and geospatial analytics company that built and operated the SkySat constellation of high-resolution Earth-observation satellites. Google acquired Skybox Imaging in 2014 for roughly $500 million and rebranded it Terra Bella. In 2017 Alphabet/Google sold Terra Bella and its SkySat satellites to Planet Labs, folding the business into Planet's Earth-observation operations. Terra Bella no longer exists as an independent operating entity and publishes no independent developer portal, API, or SDK surface; its capabilities live on inside Planet Labs. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners.

companies.name: Ursa Space Systems
companies.description: Ursa Space Systems is an Ithaca, New York-based geospatial intelligence company that turns commercial satellite data — primarily Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery, combined with electro-optical, RF, AIS, and other ground-truth feeds — into decision-ready insight reports. The company operates a GeoAI platform branded "From pixels to insights" that fuses 90+ geospatial data sources and ingests imagery from a global network of commercial SAR and EO satellite operators, then applies in-house remote-sensing, data science, and GIS expertise to deliver answers about what is happening on the ground at specific places and times. Ursa Space serves U.S. Government customers — including U.S. Space Force Space Systems Command (SSC) under INDOPACOM, AFRICOM, and SOUTHCOM, the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA) under the Luno A and Luno B delivery orders, the Defense Innovation Unit (DIU), and humanitarian-aid agencies — as well as commercial enterprise customers in energy, commodities, supply chain, maritime, and insurance. Reporting domains span security and defense (border monitoring, military activity, maritime, dark-vessel and ship-to-ship transfer detection, airstrip monitoring), environmental and disaster response (deforestation, earthquakes, flooding, wildfires), and infrastructure and industry monitoring (construction, mining, oil and gas supply chain, power generation, space situational awareness). The platform is currently in beta and Ursa Space does not operate a public developer portal, OpenAPI reference, SDK, or self-service signup; engagement is sales-led through contact@ursaspace.com and tailored to government and enterprise contracts.

companies.name: Virgin Galactic
companies.description: Virgin Galactic is a publicly traded (NYSE: SPCE) commercial spaceflight company founded by Richard Branson that develops and operates suborbital, crewed spaceplanes for space tourism and research payloads. It flies its air-launched SpaceShipTwo-class and next generation Delta-class vehicles from Spaceport America in New Mexico, carrying private astronauts and scientific experiments to the edge of space. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Social Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. Enrichment found no public developer API, portal, or documentation surface: it is a consumer-facing space-tourism business, not an API provider.

companies.name: Zeno Power Systems
companies.description: Zeno Power Systems (Zeno Power) develops radioisotope power systems — compact "nuclear batteries" that convert the decay heat of radioisotopes into long-duration electricity for extreme environments such as the lunar surface, deep-sea infrastructure, and remote defense installations. Backed by Techstars and other investors, Zeno is a hardware and energy-systems company; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public web API, developer portal, documentation, SDK, or GitHub organization, so this profile is identity-only.

companies.name: Zephyr Fusion
companies.description: Zephyr Fusion is a Y Combinator (Fall 2025) company building the first in-orbit fusion power source: a compact, megawatt-class magnetic-confinement fusion reactor designed to enable large-scale industry in space at a fraction of the cost of equivalent solar. Founded by former Lawrence Livermore and Oak Ridge National Laboratory physicists, the company targets microgravity manufacturing, orbital data centers, defense, propulsion, and human habitation in space, exploiting the vacuum of space to accommodate larger plasma regions than Earth-based reactors. As an early-stage deep-tech hardware company, Zephyr Fusion currently publishes no public API, developer platform, SDK, or machine-readable specification; this profile captures its identity in the API Evangelist network. An enrichment pass on 2026-07-21 confirmed no API surface exists (no api./docs./developer. hosts resolve; no /developers, /docs, or /.well-known discovery surface is published).

companies.name: Frontier Group Holdings
companies.description: Frontier Group Holdings is the parent company of Frontier Airlines, an ultra low-cost carrier headquartered in Denver, Colorado. The airline operates an Airbus A320-family fleet serving destinations across the United States, Mexico, Canada, the Caribbean, and Latin America. No public self-service developer API or developer portal has been identified; airline distribution and partner integrations are typically handled through GDSs, NDC channels, and direct travel-agent agreements.

companies.name: Allegiant Travel
companies.description: Allegiant Travel Company is a leisure-focused U.S. airline holding company and a Fortune 1000 firm operating Allegiant Air, which provides low-cost, mostly nonstop flights between underserved cities and popular leisure destinations. The company also bundles air travel with hotels, rental cars, and event tickets through its allegiant.com booking platform. Allegiant does not publish a public developer portal or external API.

companies.name: JetBlue Airways
companies.description: JetBlue Airways is a low-cost airline that operates flights to destinations across the United States, Caribbean, Latin America, and Europe, known for its customer service and inflight amenities.

companies.name: DCVC (Data Collective)
companies.description: DCVC (Data Collective) is a deep-tech venture capital firm founded in 2011 and headquartered in Palo Alto and San Francisco, California. Founded and led by managing partners Matt Ocko and Zachary Bogue, DCVC backs entrepreneurs using computational and AI-driven approaches to solve trillion-dollar problems in the real world across sectors that have often seen little material progress in decades. The firm invests from early through growth stages across AI, compute and quantum, computational biology and chemistry, cybersecurity and defense, energy and climate, finance and insurance, industrial transformation and advanced manufacturing, next-gen agriculture, space, TechBio and TechMed. Across 13+ funds DCVC manages roughly $4B in assets under management (self-reported / press), making it one of the larger dedicated deep-tech franchises. Notable portfolio outcomes include companies spanning fusion energy, carbon transformation, robotics, drug discovery, and data infrastructure.

companies.name: Lux Capital
companies.description: Lux Capital is a New York City-based venture capital firm founded in 2000 by Josh Wolfe, Peter Hebert, and Robert Paull that backs entrepreneurs building companies at the frontier of science and technology, turning "sci-fi into sci-fact." The firm systematically mines academia and government research labs for breakthrough technologies that have matured beyond proof-of-concept but have not yet attracted mainstream venture attention, then makes long-term bets on contrarians and outsiders challenging the status quo. Lux invests primarily at early stage across three focus areas: AI and technology, defense/space/ manufacturing, and biotech/healthcare, with an emphasis on deep tech, robotics, and emerging science. The firm manages roughly $7 billion in assets under management across nine core funds, closing Lux Ventures IX at $1.5 billion in January 2026, and has invested in over 200 companies. Through Lux Labs, launched in 2024, the firm has also helped create more than 20 new companies. Notable portfolio companies include Anduril, Applied Intuition, Databricks, Cognition, Ramp, Runway, Recursion Pharmaceuticals, Planet, and Saildrone. Lux is headquartered in New York City with an additional office in Silicon Valley.

companies.name: Social Capital
companies.description: Social Capital is a technology investment firm founded in 2011 by Chamath Palihapitiya (a former Facebook executive) and headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with co-founders Mamoon Hamid and Ted Maidenberg. Originally a traditional venture fund that stood out by backing healthcare, financial services, education, and other hard, regulated sectors the VC community had neglected, the firm pivoted in 2018 into a technology holding company that stopped accepting outside capital and now invests from its own permanent balance sheet of roughly $2.1B, aiming to "earn like Berkshire Hathaway and invest like the Red Cross." Its thesis targets multiple emerging $10T markets across deep tech commercialization, life sciences and drug discovery, the global energy transition, and creator-economy media. Chamath became known as the "SPAC King" for taking companies public through the Social Capital Hedosophia (IPOA-IPOF) vehicles, including Virgin Galactic, Opendoor, Clover Health, and SoFi. Notable investments include Slack, Box, SurveyMonkey, Wealthfront, Netskope, Intercom, Groq, Palmetto, Saildrone, and Relativity Space.
